summary_en: ZETA extended the acquisition period for up to 200,000 shares (0.98% of outstanding shares) with a maximum budget of 35 million yen from September 30, 2026 to December 31, 2026. As of September 24, 2026, the company had acquired 32,200 shares for 7.62 million yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
title_en: Notice Regarding Extension of Acquisition Period for Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On September 25, 2026, ZETA's board of directors voted to extend the acquisition period for treasury stock for the second time. The company had initially authorized the acquisition of up to 200,000 shares (0.98% of outstanding shares, excluding treasury stock) with a maximum budget of 35 million yen, with an acquisition period originally set from March 5, 2026 to May 31, 2026. In May 2026, the period was extended to September 30, 2026. The board has now further extended the period to December 31, 2026.

As of September 24, 2026, ZETA had acquired 32,200 shares for a total of 7.62 million yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, leaving 167,800 shares and approximately 27.4 million yen of the acquisition authorization unused. The company cited the need to maintain flexibility to respond to market conditions and share price movements while adhering to insider trading regulations and governance requirements. The board determined that extending the acquisition period would provide additional opportunities to execute capital-efficient share repurchases and enhance shareholder value.
